title: Rs. 35 million robbed from Horana People’s Bank
summary: A sum of Rs. 35 million prepared for replenishing ATM machines was robbed from the Horana branch of People’s Bank by an unidentified individual this afternoon, police said.

title: Health Ministry to recruit 3,000 nursing students
summary: The Health and Mass Media Ministry has issued a special gazette notification to recruit 3,000 nursing students as part of its plan to strengthen the country’s nursing workforce and achieve its target of recruiting 13,600 nurses between 2025 and 2029.

title: 23,000 teachers to be recruited by end of 2026, says PM
summary: Prime Minister and Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education Harini Amarasuriya said approval has been granted to recruit 23,000 teachers in line with a court ruling on teacher appointments, with the recruitment process expected to be completed by the end of this year.

title: Eleven missing, nearly 50 injured in fire at elderly care home in Horana
summary: At least eleven persons are reported missing and nearly 50 others have been hospitalised after a fire broke out at an elderly care home in the Batagoda area of Horana today, police said.

title: Reports claiming suspension of Suwa Seriya ambulance service false
summary: Reports circulating on social media claiming that the Suwa Seriya ambulance service would cease operations from 8.00 p.m. today are false, informed sources confirmed.

title: Trump says Iran has agreed to not have a nuclear weapon
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said Iran has agreed not to have a nuclear weapon and that he would probably meet with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei at some point ‌if things ’’work out’’.

title: Sri Lanka Schools Dialog Under-19 League Rugby Tournament 2026
Three-wheeler operators expected Saradiel-style rule from Government
summary: National Taxi App Three-Wheelers’ Professional Collective President Jasmine Lanka says many in the industry had expected the current government and President Anura Kumara Dissanayake to follow the example of the legendary folk hero Utuwankande Sura Saradiel after coming to power.

title: NIC mandatory for 2026 G.C.E. (O/L) exam applications: Examinations Department
summary: The Sri Lanka Examinations Department has announced that it is mandatory to include the National Identity Card (NIC) number when applying for examinations conducted by the department.

title: CPC to reduce fuel import bill to USD 198 million in July
summary: Claiming that the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) had to spend USD 520 million for fuel imports in May as more shipments were procured in April, CPC Chairman D.J. Rajakaruna said today the fuel bill will be reduced to USD 198 million in July.

title: Kusal, Nissanka and Chameera Lead Sri Lanka to Series-Opening Win
summary: Sri Lanka took a 1-0 lead in the three-match ODI series with a convincing 41-run victory over West Indies at Sabina Park, thanks to key contributions from Kusal Mendis, Pathum Nissanka and Dushmantha Chameera.

title: US House votes to rein in Trump’s war powers in rebuke over Iran
summary: The US House of Representatives passed a measure that seeks to halt President Donald Trump from taking further military action in Iran.

title: Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund lies idle
summary: While many people affected by the Ditawah cyclone are still languishing in safe centres or in temporary locations waiting to be relocated, it was revealed yesterday that the ‘Rebuilding Sri Lanka’ Fund established aiming to rebuild the country following the severe devastation has not been utilised.

title: Fire at Horana elders’ home kills 11 people
summary: A total of 11 people have been confirmed dead following a massive fire that broke out at an elders’ home in Anguruwatota, Horana on Tuesday evening, police said.

title: More troubles ahead: Harsha
summary: Member of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) and chairman of the parliamentary Committee on Public Finance (COPF) Harsha de Silva yesterday predicted more trouble when it comes to the Sri Lankan economy.
